usedFor: Advogalia holds cases, clients and deadlines, and MSG91 mails people about them through “Send a Mail”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deadline” in Advogalia, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A new deadline or hearing is time sensitive, and the action mails from a template.

watchOut: A mail to someone outside waits for your approval, and “New Deadline” is polling, so expect a short delay.
